regime_context: Detector shows a contested resource leadership with Gold Miners and Industrial Metals in a tight margin, both showing high durability and trend structuring. The absolute-trend gate has not historically reduced drawdown in this market (gate_helps=false), and the track record is weak (hit rate 0.41, direction accuracy 0.32). Any lean is experimental and must be kept low conviction. Crowding flags Innovation Pharma, but no fade is warranted. The macro backdrop is dominated by AI/tech geopolitics headlines, coincident context, not a trigger.
emerging_watch: Watch for Industrial Metals to become the uncontested momentum leader (margin >0.1 vs Gold Miners) while its durability bar remains above 0.8; a confirmed leadership handoff would signal broadening resource demand. The watch is retired if the margin collapses to 0 or durability drops below 0.7.

theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: Industrial Metals ranks as the closest challenger to Gold Miners, with a high momentum score (1.367), a durability bar of 0.87, broad breadth (0.923), and no crowding (z=0.1). The Hurst tag of 'trend' supports persistent momentum in the theme. Given the historically mean-reverting tape and the gate's lack of drawdown edge here, this is an experimental overweight conditional on the trend health holding.
theses.dissent: The narrow margin to Gold Miners (0.018) and the historical propensity of A-shares to mean-revert could reverse this trend. The absolute-trend gate has not demonstrated drawdown avoidance here, so any trend-following lean is unproven.
